summary: Larry's claim for the BUILD-018 governor teardown. BUILD-018 built a session governor that enforced 0 of its 4 intended rules; this removes it surgically rather than by revert, keeps the parts that earn their place, and repairs the one capability Warwick valued. DELETED: 16 module/test/schema/fixture files (stop-controller, install-hooks, rotate-session, collect-state, worktree-recon, programme-state + its schema and two fixtures, statusline-live's siblings) plus the .claude/commands/rotate-session.md slash command; rotation is superseded by the Honcho continuity journey proven live in Phase 3. SURVIVING: ten modules — continuity, continuity-derive, reorient, worktree-guard, footer, evaluator, health-store, atomic-write, sampler, statusline-live. TWO SURGICAL DECOUPLINGS: reorient.mjs drops programme-state and rotate-session (1265 -> 347 lines), inlining only normaliseSeparators and deliberately NOT isBankingCommit whose sole consumer was deleted, while preserving exactly three behaviours — the loose-Deliverables sweep, the Honcho brief passthrough, and repo/worktree/branch verification — each now covered by new executed tests that did not exist before. footer.mjs drops programme-state. FOOTER REPAIR: next: is now a caller-supplied input defaulting to UNSET (nextModelFor and all nine UNSET_REASON members deleted, since nothing can emit them once their producer is gone), carrying MODEL/EFFORT as in 'Opus/high' with both vocabularies frozen as literals the renderer and the anchored FOOTER_RE both derive from; the context indicator is re-sourced from the session transcript via the already-registered continuity.mjs stop hook so it reaches Warwick on web and Android where the terminal statusLine never runs. HANDBACK_CODES is byte-identical to a989e68. Test counts: 496 pass before, 214 pass after, 0 fail in both; 246 of the 282 lost belong to deleted suites and 36 tested deleted subjects. NOT CLAIMED, stated plainly: the continuity.mjs stop wiring is NOT proven end-to-end because exercising it would reach Honcho and read a file under the denied secrets store, so only sampleFromTranscript is proven against a real transcript; nothing in this diff has run in CI; and worktree-guard.mjs survives as a file but was demonstrated to be INERT (it returns defer for every guarded tool once no active programme-state exists) — reported deliberately and NOT repaired, because building a replacement guard is the regrowth this reset exists to cut.
brief_excerpt:
Judge this diff against the acceptance criteria below and ONLY these. They were written BEFORE the diff existed, from the Work Order, so they cannot have been back-fitted to what was built.

B1. DELETED, each with its .test.mjs: stop-controller, install-hooks, rotate-session, collect-state, worktree-recon, programme-state (plus programme-state.schema.json, fixtures/programme-state.private-build.json, fixtures/programme-state.minimal.json). Also .claude/commands/rotate-session.md.
B2. SURVIVING and not deleted: continuity, continuity-derive, reorient, worktree-guard, footer, evaluator, health-store, atomic-write, sampler, AND statusline-live. Ten, not nine — statusline-live was moved from bin to keep because it is the only authoritative source of the context-window denominator.
B3. No surviving file under tools/governor/** imports or references a deleted module.

C1. reorient.mjs no longer imports programme-state.mjs or rotate-session.mjs.
C2. reorient.mjs still performs all three preserved behaviours: the loose-Deliverables sweep, the Honcho continuity brief passthrough, and repo/worktree/branch verification. LOSING THE SWEEP IS A FAILURE OF THE WHOLE PHASE.
C3. Only normaliseSeparators was inlined. isBankingCommit was NOT inlined - its sole consumer is deleted, so inlining it would re-grow a corpse.
C4. footer.mjs no longer imports programme-state.mjs.

D1. next: is a caller-supplied input defaulting to UNSET; nextModelFor and the programme-shaped UNSET_REASON members are deleted.
D2. Grammar is MODEL '/' EFFORT (e.g. Opus/high), UNSET still bare; both vocabularies are frozen literals that the renderer and FOOTER_RE derive from, so they cannot drift. Effort vocabulary is low|medium|high|xhigh|max.
D3. parseFooter(renderFooter(x)) round-trip identity still holds.
D4. HANDBACK_CODES is UNCHANGED - seven members, exact spelling. The constitution names it as the frozen mirror of the seven interruption codes, so any edit is a breaking change, not an edit. HIGHEST SEVERITY ROW.
D5. The context sample carries a real used_tokens and a context_window_size that is null unless authoritatively known. NO hardcoded model-to-window table anywhere. A borrowed denominator from a different model must be refused.
D6. An absolute token count is rendered when only the numerator is known; a percentage only when both are known. A fabricated percentage is a defect; a true absolute number is not.
D7. The transcript sample rides the already-registered continuity.mjs stop hook and the existing writeHealthSample. NO new module, NO settings edit.

E1. New executed tests exist for all three preserved reorient behaviours. An acceptance criterion nothing can fail is not a criterion.
E2. Mutation-tested: a corrupted health sample makes the BLIND rung fire, and a deliberate break of the sweep makes its new test fail.
E3. Test counts reported as measured, before and after, including the drop in reorient.test.mjs. Deleting tests for deleted behaviour is legitimate; hiding the drop is not.
E4. governor-tests.yml covers exactly the survivors, keeps the windows-latest runner and the failure-on-non-positive-executed-count, and drops the stale collect-state exclusion.

F1. worktree-guard.mjs must be REPORTED as inert, NOT repaired. Building a replacement guard is out of scope and is exactly the regrowth being cut.
F2. continuity.mjs and continuity-derive.mjs have no tests. Stated as a limitation, not fixed.

OUT OF SCOPE - do not report as defects: which modules Warwick chose to keep (his decision, not a code question); CLAUDE.md and .claude/settings.local.json (Larry-owned, handled separately, outside the worker's surface); prose or naming preference; the absence of malicious-handler hardening (this estate's defect bar is correctness, accidental leak, availability and audit - a first-party personal system, not a hostile-input service). The CLAUDE.md and reviewDiff.mjs portions of this range were already reviewed and approved at 6a1c5ba; re-reporting them is not useful.
